resources.string: Use this device’s Root access directly
Authorize through a running Shizuku service
Root access was denied. Allow Monica in your Root manager and retry.
No usable su command found. This device needs to be rooted first.
Root authorization or command timed out. Check your Root manager and retry.
Root is not authorized. Tap Authorize Root to continue.

This requires an already rooted device and approval in its Root manager. Monica uses Root only for the system settings needed by enhanced accessibility recovery and the default password manager. It does not unlock your vault or read other app data.

Enhanced recovery only reconnects an already enabled Monica accessibility service. Once enabled, it can continue after an app or device restart and may briefly interrupt filling.

Disable Root here to stop future use. To revoke system authorization, remove Monica from your Root manager. Root is never requested as a fallback for Shizuku.
Setting the default password manager requires Android 14 or later.
